product_invariant: One persistent DSH shell contains native Chat, Sessions, Tasks, the Task Graph and focused Task Workspaces; VibeHub never appears as a nested application.

variants.reason: VibeHub manages work to completion, so committed Tasks deserve the primary stable destination while normal Chat remains one click away.
Lower-disruption fallback for DSH users who expect native Chat on first boot; the same Tasks destination and Focus Route remain available.

forbidden: synthetic Session for the global Task Graph

surface_map.reason: Stock rc.8 exposes no additive top-level destination seat; a stable Tasks destination cannot be inserted through sidebar.footer.action without placing primary navigation at the foot.

surface_map.dsh_seam: conversation single owner and its child slots
surface_map.reason: Native Session, models, tools, approvals, input state and composer remain the trusted Chat implementation.

surface_map.dsh_seam: center-column product route selected by the shadow sidebar
surface_map.reason: A global Task Graph must not pretend to be a Session conversation.view and must not use shell.overlay as a scrolling page.

surface_map.dsh_seam: center-column Focus Route with optional native Session association
surface_map.reason: Execution, attention and Evidence need a full center surface while the sidebar remains visible and Back restores exact Graph focus.

surface_map.dsh_seam: conversation header, assistant action, turn-tail and composer slots
surface_map.reason: Create, attach and remember controls belong beside native Chat rather than in a parallel transcript UI.
Theme is the supported reskin mechanism; Root replacement is not a styling shortcut.

facts: root declares sidebar, conversation, details and shell.overlay
sidebar and conversation occupy fixed columns
shadowing SidebarRoot removes those declarations unless recreated
workspace browser fills the middle region
settings and footer actions remain bottom-pinned
native Chat exposes additive message and composer seats
composer survives the no-session to session transition

runtime_truth.task_phase_source: canonical VibeHub next_action and Outcome projection
runtime_truth.live_presence_source: unexpired trusted DSH Session observation scoped to the same Ticket and Run
runtime_truth.closeout: CLOSE_OUT may display as Running / Verifying but never claims a live Agent without trusted presence
runtime_truth.writes: The prototype is static, local-only and performs no repository write.

stop_conditions: The sidebar owner cannot recreate every stock child seat without losing native Session, Workspace or Settings behavior.
A global Task route requires a synthetic Session or DOM injection.
The selected composition requires Root replacement only to apply visual styling.
Narrow navigation cannot preserve native composer, approvals and exact Focus Route return.
An upstream change breaks any bound source fact without a passing version-specific probe.

questions: Use Tasks-first or Chat-first default landing?
Place Tasks above Workspace or inside the Workspace section?
Accept Focus Route with exact Graph focus restoration?
Keep native Chat as a route plus Task-scoped steering rather than a permanent split?
